training_rule: For each scored decision date, train only on rows whose 12-month endpoint is strictly earlier than that decision date.
selection_rule: Feature family, LambdaRank parameters and Goal/ranker blend are selected only on development_selection_dates. clean_holdout_dates are evaluated only after locked_selection.json is written.
current_facts_policy: Current company facts may map ISIN to a price-history file only; no current sector or fundamental value may be a historical model feature.
